paper.title: Algorithm 795: PHCpack: A General-Purpose Solver for Polynomial Systems by Homotopy Continuation
paper.venue: ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software 25(2), 251-276 (June 1999). The author's copy (homepages.math.uic.edu/~jan/acmtomsphcpack.pdf) was read as text via pdftotext; the ACM page itself returns 403 from this host.

stack: Ada 95 (PHCpack 1.0 sources from the TOMS 795 shar; built with GNAT 13.3.0 from Ubuntu noble .deb packages, unpacked in the sandbox)

claim.text: The black-box solver of PHCpack (phc -b) on the shipped system Demo/cyclic5 (cyclic 5-roots) finds 70 isolated solutions. Registered tolerance: exact (0). The paper's Table VI row for cyclic5 gives n=5, D=120, BZ=120, BS=106, V=70, #sols=70; the shipped Demo/READ_ME table gives the same row.

attempt: Built the authors' GNAT tree as shipped (their own 'make links' in each GNAT/ directory, nothing else) and ran 'phc -b cyclic5' in the sandbox. That run failed (STORAGE_ERROR or SIGSEGV; memory corruption from getrusage, see below). Two source patches (recipe impl/patch-src.sh) make the run complete: (1) unix_resource_usage.ads: the 1999 record used 32-bit integer fields (72 bytes) for glibc's LP64 struct rusage (144 bytes), so getrusage overflowed the record; the fields become long_long_integer and the accessors convert. This only feeds the TIMING INFORMATION printout. (2) multivariate_polynomials.adb and multivariate_laurent_polynomials.adb: the test '(vp(j).k = number) or (vp(j).p /= null)' evaluates both operands in Ada, and GNAT 13 raises CONSTRAINT_ERROR on the discriminant when k = number; the intended test is short-circuit ('or else'). Neither patch touches the homotopy, the start system, the parameters or the root-refinement. After the patches, two independent passes (fresh run directories, same built binary) each print 'Number of regular solutions : 70', singular 0, real 10, complex 60, clustered 0, failures 0. Both build passes are recorded (patched-build.txt; the patched build and the original build both compiled without error).

original_attempt.reason: The authors' tree as shipped, built with GNAT 13 and run on Demo/cyclic5: the run does not finish (memory corruption from getrusage, a 72-byte record written with 144 bytes). Across the runs the failure showed as STORAGE_ERROR (stack overflow or erroneous memory access) or SIGSEGV (exit 139). A patch for the record width came first; the short-circuit fix then exposed a CONSTRAINT_ERROR at multivariate_polynomials.adb:855 (discriminant check on vp(j).p with k = number). The authors' code is not at fault for the solver's numbers; it is at fault for the record width and the 'or' operand evaluation under a modern Ada compiler.
